read.nothing: Nothing in this answer could be read aloud as checked.
read.unavailable: This answer cannot be read aloud.

preview.sample: This is how your answers will sound when they are read aloud.

fallback.to: {from} could not speak, so {to} reads instead.
fallback.none: No voice could speak right now. The text stays on the screen.

dictation.no_source: No speech input is set up. Add a key or a local voice server in Settings → Voice.
dictation.too_short: That was too short. Press the microphone, speak, then press it again.
dictation.failed: Your speech could not be turned into text. Try again or pick another source in Settings → Voice.
dictation.fallback: The browser's speech service is not available ({code}). Recording instead: press the microphone again when you are done.

capture.unsupported: This browser cannot record from the microphone here.
capture.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings.
capture.busy: The microphone is in use by another program.
capture.worklet: The audio processing could not start. Reload the page and try again.

settings.title: Voice
settings.subtitle: Dictate questions, have answers read aloud and talk live. Checked answers are only read as far as the sentence check releases them.
settings.stt_none: No speech input is set up yet.
settings.glossary_placeholder: One per line or separated by commas
settings.glossary_hint: Helps the transcription spell your names and terms. Sent only with your recordings.
settings.tts_hint: If the chosen source fails, the browser's own voices take over; nothing switches to another cloud service.
settings.local_label: Address of the local voice server
settings.local_hint: A speech server on your own computer (for example faster-whisper with Piper). Only Piper voices with an open licence are used.
settings.eleven_hint: Only ElevenLabs' premade voices are used. The key stays in this browser like your other keys.
settings.local_invalid: Enter an http or https address, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000.
settings.key_failed: The key could not be saved. Unlock the key vault and try again.

privacy.title: Where your voice goes
privacy.browser: Recognition runs on the browser vendor's servers in most browsers; on-device where the browser offers it.
privacy.gemini: Audio goes to Google, with your key directly or with this site's key through this site.
privacy.openai: Audio goes to OpenAI with your key.
privacy.groq: Audio goes to Groq with your key, directly or through this site's relay.
privacy.elevenlabs: The text to read goes to ElevenLabs, with your key or this site's key.
privacy.local: Audio and text stay on your computer.
privacy.companion: Audio stays on your machines, through the paired companion.
